translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
translations.en.yusufali: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memberikan kepadamu nikmat yang banyak.

translations.en.sahih: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
translations.en.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka dirikanlah shalat karena Tuhanmu; dan berkorbanlah.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
translations.en.yusufali: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang membenci kamu dialah yang terputus.
